title: Skip suffix conjunctions in clause-log assume's equivalence search
summary: The clause-log replay now checks an assumed clause for equivalence only against conjuncts over the clause's own symbols and leaf conjuncts covering them, instead of every suffix of a long nested conjunction. A QF_IDL model-checking input that took 459 s and over 12,000 solver calls to export now exports in a few seconds and verifies in Lean, with no change to what is trusted.
